newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firm, low sulphur up on arb play.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, low sulphur up on arb play.

text.p: NWE oil products were stronger on Thursday, traders said.
Gas oil prices climbed $2 a tonne as underlying IPE futures gained but premiums were unchanged. Sellers of heating oil barges held around $1.50 over June.
Low sulphur was boosted $2 by U.S. swaps buying, as traders tried to open the arb window to the States. High sulphur barges gained $1 on pre-holiday weekend bunker demand.

Gasoline was firm supported by run cuts at Texaco's Nerefco refinery in Rotterdam. Eurograde barges were quoted at $201.50/$203 fob ARA. Naphtha was steady in a quiet market. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
